run_xla_call_module: run the _xla_call_module function to parse a XlaCallModule op and return a callable JAX function
refine_polymorphic_shapes: refine polymorphic shapes inside a StableHLO module using static input operand shapes
convert_platform_aliases: convert platform strings like cuda or rocm to their gpu alias for backend matching
check_target_platforms: check if the current JAX backend matches the target platforms specified in a XlaCallModule proto
deserialize_stablehlo_module: deserialize a portable StableHLO artifact from a XlaCallModule proto attribute into an MHLO module
